scope: Read-only dependency, license and candidate-commit privacy audit; no installs, source/manifest edits, force fixes, or app control.

sources.inventoryMethod: Authorized disposable docker run --rm --network none; entrypoint node reads package metadata only.

misleadingWorkspaceProductionAudit.reason: npm workspace audit with omit=dev still includes BetterAuth optional Expo/React Native peers from full lock; Dockerfile intentionally excludes optional peers and copies only locked Sharp platform libraries.

limitations: Existing image predates final release lock/source. Rebuild and repeat exact inventory bulk audit before a shipped-image claim.
npm advisories do not cover operating-system packages or native libraries compiled into libvips/Hermes; separate native/OS vulnerability review remains.

directAdvisories.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements
sprintf-js vulnerable to denial of service through unbounded precision specifiers
uuid: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided

classification.boundary: Expo code signing, Metro pattern matching, Jest/NYC formatting; build/test toolchain, absent from inspected service image. Expo/RN higher-level findings are inherited advisories, not distinct native app vulnerabilities.
classification.remediation: Official current npm latest braces 3.0.3, node-forge 1.4.0, sprintf-js 1.1.3 are still in affected ranges. No compatible patched release was found; avoid untrusted build patterns/certificates, record risk acceptance and monitor upstream. Do not downgrade Expo/Jest automatically.

classification.boundary: Expo CLI/Xcode tooling references; buffer argument v3/v5/v6 bounds issue. App native graph label alone does not prove inclusion/reachability in immutable Hermes bundle.
classification.remediation: Advisory fixed >=11.1.1; current npm latest 14.0.3. Prefer upstream compatible toolchain patch; a cross-major override needs API compatibility checks.

dependencies.nativeBundleConclusion: No current evidence establishes exploitability in the shipped native application. Expo/Jest/Metro packages are installed for native builds; audit severity propagated through dependencies does not establish runtime inclusion. Recheck final embedded bundle and native-component SBOM if distributing.

findings.finding: Actual image ships libvips shared object with 29 bundled-library license entries in README.md. Generator ignores README and package has no LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE, so shipped notices omit component matrix, LGPL license and corresponding-source/relinking obligations.
findings.remediation: Collect actual pinned sharp-libvips build provenance, component license texts and corresponding sources or valid compliant source offer; preserve README matrix; review LGPL dynamic-link/replacement obligations before artifact distribution. Follow GNU LGPL v3 https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html and pinned upstream https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips . Do not describe inventory alone as compliance.

findings.finding: 82 full-tree packages lack top-level notices. Actual runtime includes @better-auth/utils 0.4.2 and nested 0.5.0, abstract-logging 2.0.1, pg-types 2.2.0 and pgpass 1.0.5 without top-level notices. Local workspace package false positives covered by root MIT license.
findings.remediation: Review pinned upstream source copyright/license notices for redistributed packages; choose BSD-3-Clause branch for node-forge dual license if ever redistributing toolchain.

privacy.sourceSecretScan: No private-key blocks, recognizable live vendor keys or literal bearer values found by this targeted scan. Does not certify all screenshot pixels or unusual secret formats. Fixture passwords/tokens are allowed when explicitly fictional; generated live-shaped session cookies are excluded even for test owner.
privacy.ignoredRuntimeCheck: git ls-files --cached .runtime .env returned empty; .runtime/ and .env* ignored. Docker context excludes scratch, evidence and environment files.

commitRecommendation.blocking: Do not git add .: candidate raw artifacts include ~1.57 GB and session cookies. Preserve local evidence without deleting it.
deterministicAllowlist: Source/config/license manifests: explicit root filenames + apps/, packages/, scripts/, docs/ after source secret scan; existing ignores exclude generated dist/native/runtime.
Planning: .scratch/**/map.md, spec.md, tickets.md, implementation.md, decisions.tsv, issues/*.md and research/*.md.
Evidence: explicit reviewed file paths only; retain this sanitized JSON, compact final verification receipts, source/image/lock hashes and selected screenshots with fictional records.
denylist: all logs/archives by default unless explicitly scrubbed and reviewed
commitRecommendation.recommendedIgnoreStrategy: Ignore entire evidence output trees and selectively force-add reviewed exact receipt/screenshot paths, or explicit extension/subdirectory raw-artifact ignores. Keep verifier/fixture source scripts separately allowlisted so reproducibility survives. Review git diff --cached --stat and staged secret scan before commit.
